description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting, which implements a strategy for fixing the nesting of HTML tokens to ensure they conform to HTML element rules, including validation and correction of child elements and exclusions.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_FixNesting
classes.description: A class that implements a strategy to fix and validate the nesting of HTML tokens based on HTML element rules.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that processes a list of tokens, validates and corrects their nesting according to HTML rules, and returns the processed token list.
